text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the Osaka Hai, Sirius Symboli proved 
her true strength to the URA officials who 
came to observe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Takarazuka Kinen. 
It is chosen as leverage to build a case 
for racing overseas, as well as keeping 
future sights set on the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.
